⚠ This permanently discards every add, edit, remove and import made since this reset feature shipped, and restores all 1,052 outlets to that original state — for everyone using the app. This cannot be undone.

Export outlet sheet

×

The sheet uses the same column names as the Pumps tab of the pump workbook, so an exported file can be filled in and handed straight back through Import outlet sheet.

Import outlet sheet

×

Updates existing site data from a sheet that carries the required column names of the export below — optional columns may be left out, and any cell left blank keeps the outlet's existing value rather than clearing it. A sheet missing a required column, or carrying columns that don't belong, is rejected and nothing is changed.

Required columns (—)
Optional columns (0) — may be left out of the sheet entirely

Import & export columns

×

These names are used for both the exported sheet's headers and what an imported sheet must be titled. Uncheck Required for a column that some outlets have no data for — a sheet may then leave it out entirely, and every row simply comes back with that field empty.
